title: Null-space private residual after shared Mirror edit
hypothesis: A rank-4 shared edit basis fitted on training edits, plus per-edit rank-q private residuals, preserves held-out edit efficacy and protected-key locality at lower complete bytes/compute than storing projected full edits. Shared and private components are both constrained to the protected-key null space. Native PCA/shared-plus-private controls must be matched.

task.metric: held-out response NRMSE, protected-key leakage ratio, actual serialized bytes, active MAC proxy and CPU wall time

development.selection_metric: smallest private rank meeting NRMSE<=.02 and leakage<=1e-6; compare complete bytes and compute

controls: Projected full edit matrix table with protected keys charged
Shared PCA rank-4 edit basis with no private residual
Shared PCA basis plus per-edit rank-q private null-space residual
Native PCA/shared-plus-private residual control with same basis and factors

paid_objects: projected full edits or shared basis and coefficients

compute: full matrix or shared/private low-rank application MACs per held-out example
basis coefficient and residual decode operations
one-time complete edit-bank reconstruction MACs and wall time, plus held-out application; reconstruction cost is charged without assuming repeated-query amortization
success_gate: For rho=0 shared q0 must achieve NRMSE<=1e-5, leakage<=1e-6 and complete bytes<=75% projected full. For rho=.05/.2 at least one q>0 must meet NRMSE<=.02 and leakage<=1e-6 with bytes below projected full; report minimum q and compute. Mirror-specific success requires strict Pareto gain over native shared-plus-private PCA.
failure_gate: Failure to meet quality/locality/byte gate or exact native PCA/private-residual alias without strict Pareto gain; fresh remains sealed after alias.
boundaries: Synthetic linear edit-response task only; no model-editing or language claim
Shared basis is fit only on first 24 training edits; held-out edits are not used for basis fit
Both shared basis atoms and private residual factors are projected into the protected-key null space
A private-only projection cannot cancel leakage from an unsafe shared component
All protected keys and residual factors are charged in complete payload
No claim of LOKI algorithm reproduction

Implementation amendment before corrected rerun: initial MAC proxy counted rank-factor application but omitted materializing full shared basis matrices from serialized PCA basis/codes. Preserve initial run under source/attempts/initial_undercharged_shared_compute; corrected proxy charges M*R*D^2 basis reconstruction and M*q*D^2 private reconstruction plus held-out matrix applications. Fresh remains sealed.
